newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen down,but analysts stay friendly.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen down,but analysts stay friendly.

text.p: MAY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30

Despite an easing Wednesday and the possibility of a further reduction in prices on Thursday, technical analysts remain friendly to cocoa, seeing easier prices as correcting a more established uptrend.
Traders were expecting cocoa to open around seven stg lower.
"Probably at this stage one would have to remain friendly, while 980 holds," Adrian Haylor, analyst at Sucden, said. He put the nearest support at 1,000 stg, but felt 980 stg was more significant.
Falls in price Wednesday had been corrective to the upward move. "I see the move up as more part of the more impulsive move at the end of March," Haylor said. The short term downside was corrective.

New York CSCE cocoa futures ended broadly lower in sluggish trading Wednesday, dragged down by speculative selling of the nearby May/July switch ahead of the spot month's delivery period, dealers said.
New York had headed lower at the outset on the heels of losses in London, traders said.
